title: cifra.md setlist
description: The result of reading a setlist (spec §10.6). Everything a conforming reader produces, and everything a canonical writer (§10.9) needs. This formalizes the §10.6 prose model; it mirrors the JSON the reader emits, which carries three things the §10.6 structure block abbreviates away: a `type` discriminator on every entry, item and notes block, the `number` on every item, and the `diagnostics` array (§10.6, §10.8.3). Resolution (§10.8) is not part of what reading produces and is not modelled here.

title.description: The text of the level-1 heading, or null when there is no title or its text is empty (§10.3.1).

properties.description: The property list under the title, in order (§10.3.1). Order is significant.

body.description: The items and notes blocks of the setlist, in document order (§10.6): each element is a song or unlinked item, or a notes block.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics reported by reading, sorted by line (§10.6, §10.8.3).

Entry.description: An entry: a property (`key: value`) or an unrecognised line, selected by `type` (§10.3.3; a top-level property §10.3.1). The §10.6 box abbreviates the `type` discriminator away.

PropertyEntry.description: A `key: value` property. The reserved keys are `key` and `note`; any other key is application-defined (§10.7). Keys are lower-cased (§10.7, §1.4.3).

value.description: The rest of the line after the colon and the spaces after it; may be empty (§10.3.3).

UnrecognisedEntry.description: A line under the title or an item that is not `key: value`; kept as written (§10.3.3).

BodyElement.description: An element of the body: a song item, an unlinked item, or a notes block, selected by `type` (§10.6, document order).

SongItem.description: An item that is a song link (§10.3.2, §10.4, §10.5). The §10.6 box abbreviates the `type` discriminator and `number` away.

path.description: The link destination's decoded segments joined by `/` (§10.5).

UnlinkedItem.description: An item that is not a song link; kept, and skipped when playing (§10.3.2). The §10.6 box abbreviates the `type` discriminator and `number` away.

Notes.description: A notes block between items (§10.3.4). The §10.6 box abbreviates the `type` discriminator away.

lines.description: The block's lines, in order; a blank line inside the block is kept as `""` (§10.3.4).

Diagnostic.description: A diagnostic reported by reading: a code, a message and a line (§10.8.3). The known codes are `duplicate-key`, `unrecognised-entry`, `bad-key`, `backslash-in-path`, `bad-path`, `unlinked-item` and `unclosed-fence`; `code` is left a string, not an enum, so §10.8.3 stays the single source of the diagnostics table. A setlist diagnostic has no `text` field.
